Web Developer Intern

Company: CREM Canada.

Location: 360 Beach Rd Hamilton

Job type: Internship, full time

Term: Upto 12 months

Pay: $22 to $23 per hour, based on experience (approximately $45,760 to $47,840 per year, based on 40

hours per week)

Reports to: Operations Manager

About Us

CREM Canada is a construction contracting company that has served Canada since 2017. We provide insulation and general contracting services for residential and commercial clients, and our team of 16 employees takes pride in quality workmanship, safety, and honest communication with our clients. We are investing in our online presence and internal tools, and we are looking for a web development intern who wants real experience building websites for a growing business.

About the Internship

As our Web Developer Intern, you will help maintain and improve our company website and build

simple tools for our office staff, site crews, and clients. You will work directly with ownership and our

team on real projects from day one, so you will finish the internship with work you can show in your

portfolio. This is a great fit for a student who enjoys learning by doing and wants to see how a business

uses technology.

What You Will Do

 Update and maintain our website, including project galleries, service pages, and contact forms

 Help redesign pages to be fast, mobile friendly, and accessible

 Build and test quote request and lead capture forms

 Support on page SEO and keep our Google Business Profile listing accurate

 Help build simple internal tools, such as a project photo upload page or a scheduling request form

 Fix bugs, test changes across browsers and devices, and document what you build

 Help check that the website meets AODA and WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility standards

 Help track website traffic and leads using Google Analytics

Who We Are Looking For

 Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a college or university program in Computer

Science, Web Development, or a related field

 Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through school, personal, or freelance projects

 Some exposure to WordPress or another content management system

 Basic understanding of responsive design

 Familiarity with Git or a willingness to learn it quickly

 Curious, organized, and comfortable asking questions

 Good communication skills and the ability to explain your work to non technical coworkers

 Legally eligible to work in Canada

 A portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of websites or projects you have built

Nice to Have

 Experience with React, Vue, or another JavaScript framework

 Some back end experience with PHP, Node.js, or Python, or with databases such as MySQL

 Basic design skills in Figma or Canva

 Interest in construction, trades, or small business

 Eligibility for a co-op or internship program through your school

What We Offer

 Pay of $22 to $23 per hour, based on experience, which works out to approximately $45,760 to

$47,840 per year for a 40 hour week

 Real, hands on work that goes straight into your portfolio

 One on one mentorship from ownership and senior staff

 Hybrid work schedule, Monday to Friday

 Flexibility around exams and school schedules

 Support with co-op or internship credit paperwork for your school

 A reference letter on successful completion, and the possibility of a full time role after graduation

 A friendly, close knit team where your ideas are heard

How to Apply

Please send your resume, a short cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or GitHub to crem.canada@gmail.com

with the subject line "Web Developer Intern Application, [Your Name]". Please mention your program,

expected graduation date, and the term you are available for.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until [closing date]. We thank all applicants for their

interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodation

CREM Canada is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified

candidates, including students from all backgrounds. We are committed to an inclusive and accessible

workplace. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the

hiring process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know at [email address] and we will work

with you to meet your needs.

Pay: $23.33-$46.69 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person
